Resolution: >=300 DPI for line art with color; >=600 DPI preferred for line art
Preferred formats: TIFF, EPS, PDF, or PS; PNG accepted for review
Font: sans-serif (Arial, Helvetica, Times acceptable), 8-10 pt at final size; no smaller than 6 pt
Figure titles: No titles inside the figure; brief descriptive caption below the figure; panel labels (a), (b), ... in lowercase
Statistical reporting: State the number of realizations / windows behind any error bar or distribution; state the estimator's degrees of freedom where noise levels are compared
